content: Clarithromycin is a semi-synthetic macrolide antibiotic. Chemically, it is known as 6-O-methylerythromycin. Its molecular formula is C38H69NO13, and it has a molecular weight of 747.96. The substance appears as a white to off-white crystalline powder. It is soluble in acetone, slightly soluble in methanol, ethanol, and acetonitrile, but is practically insoluble in water. Clarithromycin is marketed under the brand name BIAXIN and is available in several formulations: immediate-release tablets, extended-release tablets, and granules for oral suspension. Each yellow, oval, film-coated immediate-release BIAXIN tablet contains either 250 mg or 500 mg of clarithromycin as the active ingredient. The 250 mg tablets also include the following inactive ingredients: hypromellose, hydroxypropyl cellulose, croscarmellose sodium, D&C Yellow No. 10, FD&C Blue No. 1, magnesium stearate, microcrystalline cellulose, povidone, pregelatinized starch, propylene glycol, silicon dioxide, sorbic acid, sorbitan monooleate, stearic acid, talc, titanium dioxide, and vanillin. The 500 mg tablets contain a similar composition of inactive ingredients, with the exception of FD&C Blue No. 1 and pregelatinized starch, and include colloidal silicon dioxide instead. The extended-release formulation, BIAXIN XL, is available as yellow, oval, film-coated tablets containing 500 mg of clarithromycin. The inactive ingredients in these tablets include cellulosic polymers, D&C Yellow No. 10, lactose monohydrate, magnesium stearate, propylene glycol, sorbic acid, sorbitan monooleate, talc, titanium dioxide, and vanillin. The oral suspension form of BIAXIN, after reconstitution, provides 125 mg or 250 mg of clarithromycin per 5 mL. The granules for oral suspension are available in bottles containing 1250 mg (50 mL size), 2500 mg (50 and 100 mL sizes), or 5000 mg (100 mL size) of clarithromycin. The inactive ingredients in the granules include carbomer, castor oil, citric acid, hypromellose phthalate, maltodextrin, potassium sorbate, povidone, silicon dioxide, sucrose, xanthan gum, titanium dioxide, and a fruit punch flavor.
